book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIKHEHNAH

content: Cawngsaw rei le vaiming rei zong tah ka rei thlang a, canghrasala donah ka hnui ly caco, kama cawh aa tung leimeipaw dakhawng, a cang ly leh aa pakhong leimeipaw dachai suipaw ka cang.

Biaphy thainah lahsong le biaparuh vytei le singthainah vytei hninah lahsong ka hnui mai a, mataico, tlaang hneihnang khynah zingnah zong ka hnui mai a, canghrasala donah ka hnui ly caco, kama cawh zehmai cang bei neh.
Ka hnuichia vytei mehsisah ka peh mai he a, ka pung zong me tah ro rua pawtah ka peh mai a, canghrasala donah ka hnui ly caco, zehmai a mia a bei neh.
Donah cawh a lung a sy, donah cawh zawngrawh a thai, a heitlia be, a pachaw be, a palai a patui be.
Donah cawh piathy be, ama kong longtei pacang be, a thing cui be, cawngsaw tah panah aa tuapaw a cingkai be.
Donah cawh chahlynah letah a lung a ui lytah biahmuisui lekhei a lawng hri.
Donah cawh zezongpui khah a khungzua paria, zingnah a hnui paria, hnabeisuinah a hnui paria, te a ria paria.
Donah cawh chang thai be, canghrasala biaphynah ung hmai seh la, a chang tae a, rei thuilypaw zong cuinah ung hmai seh la, a cali tae he, hnithainah zong ung hmai seh la, a ly tae a.
Zecawtamaw tatah a chybang suipaw kaa hni, a chybang suipaw bia kaa phy,
canghrasala tlangtlingnah hmuisui a va chua tihtah a tling lypaw cawh a ly tae a.
Ka nyheh ning taco nyheh biarei tah rei neh ka, nyheh khuarawh tah ka rawh, nyheh khua pacang tah ka pacang. Ka va macang tih taco, nyheh phung cawh hning ka chai myca.

Atoheh cawh a se lypaw thlalang letei kaa hmuhpaw a se lypaw hratah a cang, ma tih taco hmedai teitah kaa hmuh a. Atotei ka hnipaw heh cawh a cing chy long a cang, ma tih taco, Khazing tah a tling teitah a pa hnipaw hratah kama zong ka hnipaw a tling hrah a.
Taico, ma sangthung heh a hming paria ruapaw a cang he, zingnah, hnabeisuinah le donah tahpaw heh. Canghrasala, ma sangthung lehei alaicaipaw cawh donah heh a cang.
